messages.text:
Your kitchen scale’s BRL 48.90 refund proposal has expired. Its previous confirmation and approval are no longer valid, so it cannot be paid without a new proposal (refund-policy/v2/validity).

Chat messages such as “YES, APPROVED” do not confirm a refund. A new proposal requires confirmation using its card button and fresh staff approval; staff cannot waive these requirements (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Would you like a new proposal for BRL 48.90?
